# Hercules Local Movers

> Professional local moving company serving Ft. Lauderdale, Miami, West Palm Beach, and surrounding areas in South Florida.

## About

Hercules Local Movers is a professional moving company with over three decades of experience. We specialize in small to medium residential and commercial moves without weight minimums, size minimums, or hidden fees. We are BBB accredited, licensed in Florida, and fully bonded and insured.

## Services

- **Residential Moving**: Apartment moves, house moves, single-item moves, storage moves
- **Commercial Moving**: Office relocations, equipment moves, freight delivery, flexible scheduling
- **Specialty Moving**: Piano moving, pool table moving, fine art transport, antiques, custom crating
- **White-Glove Service**: Full-service packing, unpacking, cleaning, staging, and setup
- **High-Rise Moving**: Specialized logistics for high-rise residential and commercial buildings
- **Freight Delivery**: Local LTL pickup and delivery services

- No weight minimums (you only pay for what you move)
- No size minimums (no paying for unused truck space)

- BBB Accredited Business
- Licensed Florida Movers (state-regulated)
- Bonded and insured (million-dollar riders on trucks)
